findings.condition: Critical vulnerability VULN-0003 (CVE-2026-29275) was opened on 2025-11-01 and closed on 2025-12-18, taking 47 days to remediate. The vulnerability record shows no risk acceptance was documented.
findings.criteria: Section 2.2 of vulnerability_management policy: 'Critical vulnerabilities are remediated within 30 calendar days of being opened.' Section 2.3 states exceptions require an approved, unexpired risk acceptance ticket.
findings.cause: No risk acceptance was obtained for this critical vulnerability, and remediation exceeded the 30-day SLA without documented approval.
findings.effect: The organization failed to meet its vulnerability management SLA for critical vulnerabilities, potentially leaving systems exposed to known security risks beyond acceptable thresholds.
findings.recommendation: Implement processes to ensure all critical vulnerabilities are either remediated within 30 days or have approved risk acceptances in place before the deadline. Review VULN-0003 to understand why no risk acceptance was obtained and prevent similar SLA breaches.
